perspective:
From Jose Castillo’s perspective:

- He works with Patricia at a community bank, where he sometimes helps with equipment maintenance and repairs.
- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn than usual during their shifts, which stood out because she is usually vibrant.
- He asked if she was okay, and she said it was “nothing really,” just “personal stuff,” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk, and she said she appreciated it and that it meant a lot.
- He overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He mentioned he had been reading about financial planning strategies and offered to discuss them. She said that could be helpful and that she had been overwhelmed with bills lately.
- He offered to look over budgeting tips together, and she said she would take him up on it soon.
- He later worried he might have overstepped by bringing up finances, so he clarified that he wanted to help, not pry. Patricia said she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for the offer.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend. She said it was good to know she had someone to turn to.
- Later, he checked in with her and asked about weekend plans. She said she was doing fine and planned a quiet weekend at home, then asked about his plans.
- He said he would probably read and relax, and reminded her she could reach out if she needed anything. She thanked him and said she would keep it in mind.
- He continued checking in on her at work. She said she was busy but handling it, thanked him for checking in, and said it was great to have his support.
- He responded that he was happy to help, even just for coffee, and that they were all there to help each other.
final_response:
Jose starts out concerned when he notices Patricia seems withdrawn, then becomes worried after overhearing her phone call about bills. He later feels anxious about possibly overstepping when he brought up finances. After she reassures him and seems to be doing fine, he feels hopeful. Finally, when she says she is handling things and values his support, he feels relieved.

ANSWER: e
